page: Microsoft Azure D128nls_v6 is a virtual machine type within the network-optimized, low-memory segment of the Dnlv6 series. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provides 128 dedicated virtual central processing units alongside 256.0 GB of system memory. This resource profile establishes a compute-centric 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, yielding exactly 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware configurations for the D128nls_v6 exclude integrated local storage and physical hardware accelerators, featuring zero graphics processing units. Disks must be attached remotely, with the instance offering full compatibility with Azure Premium Storage for high-throughput persistence. Without local scratch drives, node operations depend entirely on remote network storage for operating system and application data volumes.

Cost efficiency is focused on high-density parallelism rather than heavy memory capacity. Workloads that do not require standard 1:4 memory allocation can reduce capacity overhead by leveraging the constrained 2.0 GB per vCPU footprint. The primary operational tradeoff is the lower memory ceiling alongside total reliance on remote storage fabrics for disk operations.

The D128nls_v6 is tailored for scalable, CPU-intensive workloads that require substantial parallel execution threads but moderate memory overhead. Appropriate use cases include distributed build systems, continuous integration pipelines, batch computing, high-density web application serving, and parallelized network data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure D128nls_v6 is an x86_64 Intel-based virtual machine configured on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. The instance includes no onboard local storage and no graphics processing units, utilizing Azure Premium Storage compatibility for external network volumes. By omitting local temporary drives and expansive memory footprints, the instance minimizes unused resource allocation for compute-dense scenarios. The D128nls_v6 is engineered for compute-heavy, highly parallel workloads including automated build and compilation systems, continuous integration pipelines, web tier clusters, and distributed batch processing.
